rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something has changed or increased considerably.

example.english: Rent has increased considerably this year.
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 zou1 gam1 gwai3 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Pick this for a stronger, more emphatic sense of “greatly,” especially before verbs such as 改善 or 提高.

example.english: This new arrangement has considerably improved work efficiency.
example.traditional: 呢個新安排大大改善咗工作效率。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 on1 paai4 daai6 daai6 goi2 sin6 zo2 gung1 zok3 haau6 leot6

rows.note: Use this mainly for a substantial measurable change, such as a large rise, fall, reduction, or improvement.

example.jyutping: lau4 gaa3 daai6 fuk1 dit3 zo2
